amountRoles(bytes).details: Must return an array of the same length as decodeAmounts(data).      Enables the OMS to know which slots to size (IN vs OUT) and in what      denomination (TOKEN vs ASSETS vs SHARES).      Takes data so variable-count hooks can return the correct number of slots.

params.data: The hook-specific calldata (same as passed to decodeAmounts)

returns.meta: Array of AmountMeta structs aligned index-by-index with decodeAmounts

build(address,address,bytes).details: Standard build pattern - MUST include preExecute first, postExecute last

params.account: The account to perform executions for (usually an ERC7579 account)
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

returns.executions: Array of Execution structs defining calls to make

params.pendleRouterV4_: The address of the Pendle Router V4 contract

decodeAmounts(bytes).details: Used to determine the quantity of assets or shares being processed

returns.amounts: Array of amounts (length 1 for single-amount hooks, 2+ for compound hooks)

decodeOutputQuote(bytes).details: Represents the aggregator-quoted expected output; equals outputMin for AMM hooks

decodePayload(bytes).details: payloadLength is read from offset 189 to know how many bytes to return

decodeUsePrevHookAmount(bytes).details: Used to create hook chains where output from one hook becomes input to the next

returns._0: True if the hook should use the previous hook's output amount
The complete encoded calldata: 52-byte zero prefix + Layer 1 + Layer 2

getOutAmount(address).details: This is the primary output value used by subsequent hooks

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

returns._0: The amount of tokens (assets or shares) processed

getOutToken(address).details: Used by subsequent hooks to determine what token the previous hook produced      PASSTHROUGH hooks auto-forward the previous hook's outToken      TRANSFORM hooks set this to their specific output token

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

returns._0: The address of the output token, or address(0) if not set

getPendleTradeResult(address).details: Output side reuses BaseHook's transient getOutToken/getOutAmount; input side + operation +      market come from this hook's execution-context-keyed transient TradeResult store (same      isolation as outAmount/outToken). `operation == NONE` means no PendlePTHook trade ran for      `account` in the current execution context.

params.account: The account the trade was executed for.

returns.result: The trade result (operation + input/output token + input/output amount).

inspect(bytes).details: Returns only the yieldSource (20 bytes). The market lock is direction-agnostic:      the market's PT may be the input (sell/redeem) or the output (buy).

returns._0: The arguments of the hook encoded

postExecute(address,address,bytes).details: Called after the main execution, used to update hook state and calculate results      Sets output values (outAmount, usedShares, etc.) for subsequent hooks

params.account: The account operations were performed for
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

preExecute(address,address,bytes).details: Called before the main execution, used to validate inputs and set execution context      This method may perform state changes to set up the hook's execution state

params.account: The account to perform operations for
params.data: The hook-specific parameters and configuration data
params.prevHook: The address of the previous hook in the chain, or address(0) if first

params.amounts: The amounts to replace (must match length from decodeAmounts)
params.data: The data to replace amounts in

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

setExecutionContext(address).details: Used for security validation between preExecute and postExecute calls

params.caller: The caller address for context identification

setOutAmount(uint256,address).details: Used for updating `outAmount` when fees were deducted

params.caller: The caller address for context identification
params.outAmount: The amount of tokens processed by the hook

subtype().details: Used to categorize hooks beyond the basic HookType      For example, a hook might be of type INFLOW but subtype VAULT_DEPOSIT

returns._0: A bytes32 identifier for the specific hook functionality

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

SUB_TYPE().notice: The specific subtype identifier for this hook

amountRoles(bytes).notice: Returns per-slot metadata (direction + denomination) for each amount

asset().notice: The primary asset address this hook operates on

build(address,address,bytes).notice: Builds the execution array for the hook operation

constructor.notice: Initializes the PendlePTHook with the Pendle Router V4 address

decodeAmounts(bytes).notice: Extracts all amounts from the hook's calldata

decodeInputAmount(bytes).notice: Decode the input amount from hook calldata (offset 92)

decodeInputToken(bytes).notice: Decode the input token address from hook calldata (offset 52)

decodeOutputMin(bytes).notice: Decode the minimum acceptable output from hook calldata (offset 156)

decodeOutputQuote(bytes).notice: Decode the output quote from hook calldata (offset 124)

decodeOutputToken(bytes).notice: Decode the output token address from hook calldata (offset 72)

decodePayload(bytes).notice: Decode the protocol-specific payload from hook calldata (starting at offset 221)

decodeUsePrevHookAmount(bytes).notice: Determines if this hook should use the amount from the previous hook

description().notice: One-sentence description of what this hook does

encodeSwapData((address,address,uint256,.notice: Encode the full hook calldata from a Layer 1 header and a protocol-specific payload

executionNonce().notice: Execution nonce for creating unique contexts

getOutAmount(address).notice: The amount of tokens processed by the hook in a given caller context, subject to fees after update

getOutToken(address).notice: The output token address produced by the hook in a given caller context

getPendleTradeResult(address).notice: Returns the completed PT trade for `account` in the current execution context.

hookType().notice: The type of hook (NONACCOUNTING, INFLOW, OUTFLOW)

setExecutionContext(address).notice: Sets the caller address that initiated the execution

setOutAmount(uint256,address).notice: Sets the output amount for the hook

spToken().notice: The special token address (if any) associated with this hook's operation

subtype().notice: Returns the specific subtype identification for this hook

usedShares().notice: The number of shares used by this hook's operation
